body: Fourth and final hero from the S170-93 batched hero-wave. Real TYLER canon #14, 2.22 Hz love-triangle/escalation theme. Passive flat armor, Q ranged bolt+burn, W instant silence-only decree, R the roster's first delayed-payoff ultimate (marks target position, silent fuse, one-time burst on zero). ARENA_HERO_COUNT 24->25. 6 new tests, found+fixed 2 real test bugs (chase-bot contamination, Unicorn-placeholder armor). Verified: full suite (352 checks), live match confirmed 20 distinct picks zero duplicates. Commit e118d67.
title: Beleth, the Detonation, 25th hero (S170-93 batch)
